name: Revenue vs Target
summary: Booked revenue for the quarter against the 1,000,000 USD target.
description: Revenue vs Target sums the Booked column by Region across the newest workbook under ${workspace}/finance/, then compares the total with the quarter target and shows the 24-hour change. The blank state names the workbook glob and the columns it needs instead of showing zero.
highlights: Sums Booked by Region across the quarter's revenue workbooks.
Progress bar against the 1,000,000 USD quarter target.
Shows the 24-hour direction so a late push is visible.
